description: Single-span humpback stone bridge, 8 m span and 2.4 m wide, with a semicircular arch, voussoir ring, paved deck and parapets with lotus-capped posts.
size_note: Approx. 9.6 x 2.8 x 2.6 m; deck crown 1.45 m above the ends.
modeling_method: ten concept sketches drawn first, loaded as reference images, then modelled from the shared design spec; ten views rendered from the same model
